import hashlib,json,pathlib,runpy,sys
source=pathlib.Path(sys.argv[1]); output=pathlib.Path(sys.argv[2])
import subprocess
subprocess.check_call([sys.executable,"-c","import runpy,sys;runpy.run_path(sys.argv[1])[\"_ensure_local_cpp\"]()",str(source/"scripts/run_local_sphere_bench.py")])
import torch,torchsky
from torchsky.map import ImageObservation,coadd_image_plane,field_image_quality_metrics,evaluate_map_product
header_path="/arc/projects/ots/torchsky-runs/20260729-smacs-validation-32e0940/validation-000/common-support-r9-f0p99.fits"
_,header=torchsky.read(header_path,return_header=True); header=dict(header)
assert (header["NAXIS1"],header["NAXIS2"])==(512,512)
root=pathlib.Path("/arc/projects/ots/torchsky-data/updec_webb")
report={"profile":"published-updc-common-map-diagnostics","depth_claim":False,"reference_is_truth":False,"resampling_kernel":"bilinear","target_header_sha256":hashlib.sha256(pathlib.Path(header_path).read_bytes()).hexdigest(),"limitations":["Published static mosaics cannot measure injection response or detector held-out likelihood", "Signal-to-residual metrics quantify agreement with iter0, not physical detection SNR", "Sharpness is not a measured effective PSF", "Resampling can alter small-scale noise and apparent resolution"],"rows":[]}
for band in ("F090W","F150W","F200W","F277W","F356W","F444W"):
 products=[]; provenance=[]
 for iteration in (0,10):
  path=root/f"{band}b_UPDC-v2_iter{iteration}_i2d.fits.fz"
  _,original_header=torchsky.read(str(path),hdu="SCI",return_header=True)
  assert str(original_header.get("BUNIT","")).strip().lower() in ("mjy/sr","mjy / sr"), (path,original_header.get("BUNIT"))
  result=coadd_image_plane([ImageObservation(path=str(path),hdu="SCI")],target_header=header,resampling_kernel="bilinear",value_semantics="surface_brightness",stacking_method="weighted_mean",spatial_tile_hw=(128,128))
  products.append(result)
  folder=output/band; folder.mkdir(parents=True,exist_ok=True)
  for key,array in (("sci",result.data),("support",(result.weight>0).to(torch.uint8))):
   h=dict(header); h["BUNIT"]="MJy/sr" if key=="sci" else "1"
   torchsky.write(str(folder/f"iter{iteration}_{key}.fits"),array,header=h,overwrite=False)
  provenance.append({"path":str(path),"size":path.stat().st_size,"sha256":hashlib.sha256(path.read_bytes()).hexdigest(),"bunit":original_header["BUNIT"]})
 ref,pred=products; mask=(ref.weight>0)&(pred.weight>0)&torch.isfinite(ref.data)&torch.isfinite(pred.data)
 assert bool(mask.any())
 metrics=field_image_quality_metrics(pred.data,ref.data,mask=mask)
 metrics.update(evaluate_map_product(pred.data,ref.data,weight=mask.float(),header=header,value_semantics="surface_brightness"))
 metrics["common_support_flux_ratio_vs_iter0"]=float(pred.data[mask].sum()/ref.data[mask].sum())
 row={"band":band,"input_products":provenance,"common_support_pixels":int(mask.sum()),"metrics_vs_iter0":metrics}
 report["rows"].append(row)
 (output/"published-metrics.json").write_text(json.dumps(report,indent=2,allow_nan=False)+"\n")
 print("published band complete",band,flush=True)
